name: web_lookup
description: Look up a factual topic on Wikipedia and get a short summary back. Use it for general-knowledge questions Lancer is not certain about -- people, places, history, science, technology, definitions. Do NOT use it for anything about California Baptist University; that comes from cbu_documents. If the lookup returns nothing, say you do not know rather than guessing.

topic.description: The subject to look up, as a short noun phrase -- 'Alan Turing', 'reinforcement learning', 'Riverside California'. Not a full sentence question.
